clips.title: The story
paras: The Field of Giants spreads across the southern Barrens, from Camp Taurajo to Dustwallow's marshes. Towering kodo, thunder lizards, and other great beasts graze its dry scrub, while silithids make the plain more dangerous.

The Field of Giants follows the southern Gold Road, far from the Barrens' better-defended north. Wooden watchtowers along the road sit largely abandoned, while great herds roam the open flats. Hunters and naturalists come to see Kalimdor's enormous beasts, but the land is not safe. Dwarven excavators from Bael Modan dig aggressively to the south, and a more sinister threat has begun burrowing underground.

Silithid hives have recently broken through the ground across the Field of Giants. They mark the northernmost known sighting of these ravenous creatures in Kalimdor. Their strange mounds and aggressive swarms have alarmed the Horde. Korran, a troll scout from the Crossroads, and Ruga Ragetotem, a tauren warrior at Camp Taurajo, urge adventurers to investigate the hives and learn what draws these horrors so far from the deep deserts.
